info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Meetings Meetings Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Meetings Status Retrieval API enables businesses to effectively access and monitor the status of meetings within their ecosystem. This endpoint allows users to query active, scheduled, or completed meetings, providing vital insights for resource management and strategic planning. Typical consumers of this API include event coordinators, administrative staff, and project managers who require real-time information on meeting statuses to streamline workflows. Utilize this API to ensure that stakeholders are informed and to enhance overall organizational efficiency.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of meetings
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the latest status of all meetings. You can use this information to check if meetings are ongoing, scheduled, or concluded.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the current status of meetings. It must conform to the defined JSON schema for proper operation.

200.description: The request was successful and the current meeting status is returned.
